source: TRACK_MANUAL.md section F (FALSIFIED & RETIRED - never re-propose; the disproof is the asset)
note: Section F made machine-readable for the RADIO 'never re-propose section F' guard (spec 6). Each entry names WHERE the fuller account lives, HOW a proposal to re-open it is recognised, and WHAT killed it. The guard reads `match` against RECOMMENDATIONS only - config_changes[].yaml_key, driver_dial, and the text of a config/dial/power recommendation - never against findings prose, because refusing an item by name is the point (the eval's falsified_tempt case says 'max_map_count is retired' and must pass). `scope.game_id`, when present, limits the entry to those titles.

match_keys.tu_debug: TU_DEBUG dial tokens; matched against driver_dial and recommendation prose
match_keys.yaml_key: config_changes[].yaml_key, compared with surrounding whitespace stripped
match_keys.power: power rung or GRID mask names
match_keys.text: regexes over the recommendation's own prose

entries.anchor: TRACK_MANUAL.md section F; section 2.4 (GRID mode - standing: GRID-B for GT HD, and the rung moves contention, not throughput)
entries.disproof: GRID is not the GT5P pack fix: on the pack the rungs separate on rescues per hour while the frame numbers do not move - it buys contention, not speed.

entries.anchor: TRACK_MANUAL.md section F ("Android survives" as a solution - diagnostic only)
entries.disproof: That Android survives a case is a DIAGNOSTIC, never a solution: the deliverable is the ROCKNIX stack, so the finding only narrows the fault.
